F1_ipcConflictDisappearsFromPersistence.note: the Tracker rebuilds ONE observation whose dshSessionId is always the FIRST observed id; the Recorder persists only that field and never reads conflictingSessionId, so A/B/C collapse to a durable candidate set of {A}

F2_multiInvocationMixedStateSelection.note: selectInvocation returns SELECTED_UNIQUE for exactly one qualified invocation WITHOUT consulting the unresolved states of the other invocations, so I-1 QUALIFIED + I-2 OBSERVATION_INCOMPLETE reports 'no unresolved alternative exists'

F3_raceDuringEventRead.note: the qualifier rechecks currentness BEFORE returning; the attributed adapter then reads the session page and builds the binding with no second relevant-basis check, so a conflict committed during Event Read is admitted as current

F4_aggregateQualificationCurrentness.note: qualifyAttempt captures ONE basis before the pass and each invocation rechecks only against that snapshot; an early invocation can already have been returned ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED while a later invocation's read reveals a change, so the aggregate result is not bound to one confirmed basis

F5_prematureTerminalFinalization.note: the port resolves the promise from the timeout/abort handler BEFORE any child close is observed, and the delegation finalizes the window with the single closeReason INVOCATION_RETURNED, so an unclosed Invocation is recorded CLOSED

F6_attemptWideFinalizationScope.note: onTerminal calls finalizeAttempt, which closes EVERY invocation the store knows for the attempt, so a terminal for one Job finalizes unrelated Invocations

F7_crossAttemptDuplicateProducerIdentity.note: the observation event id is scoped by attemptId, so the same source-scoped SessionId claimed by two Attempts yields two distinct records that qualify independently; there is no source-scoped cross-attempt creator check

F8_invariantRefusedPreviewMetadata.note: events ARE refused when invariants fail, but sessionLifecycle, eventPageCoverage and completeness are computed from the page and the admission flag only, so a refused page can still report SESSION_READ + FULL + COMPLETE

F9_memoryDurabilityOverclaim.note: deriveExecutionAssociationPath accepts ':memory:' and the qualifier sets verification VERIFIED with a durableBindingRef for any record, so an in-memory store yields a BOUND_VERIFIED-looking result that cannot survive process termination

F10_readerAsyncDisposal.note: OwnedResource.close is synchronous and the reader's async close is voided, so dispose() returns before the mounted Cordis fiber is disposed

F11_sourceConfigurationMismatch.note: an explicitly supplied Worker Port replaces the derived one, but the trusted basis and FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST kind are still computed from workWorkerBin, so a stub port with a claimed first-party bin is source-qualified as first-party

F12_normalDshEnvironment.note: the reader is composed only when the host supplies DSH_HOME; without an explicit DSH_HOME no reader exists, so the supported default-home behavior is not exercised by the product path

F13_incompleteCanonicalT0View.note: the attributed adapter supplies resultRefs [], verificationState NOT_OBSERVED_BY_P2C, reworkState NONE and a null basis, and the product cluster supplies an empty project-evolution projection, so facts the V0 composition can establish are replaced by placeholders

F14_callerClaimDisagreement.note: the Caller Claim is recorded on the binding, but when it differs from the source-verified SessionId the discrepancy is not explicitly reported as a discrepancy

F15_crossAttemptContextReachability.note: previewAttempt admits ANY canonical Attempt of the project by its AttemptId with no consumer-Attempt binding, so a consumer can inspect another Attempt's history by naming it

F16_existingConsumerDeliveryMechanism.note: PriorResultContext compiled into the per-Attempt ContextManifest, delivered through the attempt-bound pull allowlist, is the narrowest existing mechanism; no unrestricted session-read tool exists

F17_historicalSourceEpochProductWiring.note: the cluster accepts historical epochs, but the install options do not expose them and install.ts never passes them, so a normal deployment cannot supply a trusted historical epoch after an upgrade

F18_publicTypeCompatibility.note: installPalimpsest returns InstalledPalimpsestWithTrajectory and the runtime object carries trajectory, but Deployment.installed is typed InstalledPalimpsest, so the extended capability is not statically reachable through the supported deployment surface
